limitations: This records an artifact specification and verifies reported file hashes; estimator loading and inference still need verification in the later evaluator.
Threshold-dependent validation metrics are recomputed; AP/ROC AUC and training scores are not recomputed here.
Validation was used repeatedly for development and early stopping; its scores are not final generalization claims.
The test protocol creates a derived balanced cohort with exclusions. Coverage and unbalanced-cohort results must be reported too.
Archived static features cannot establish resistance to dynamically loaded or delayed JavaScript on real websites.
The 0.50 threshold remains the existing comparison baseline; it does not guarantee any FPR target or calibrated deployment probability.
Specifying a protocol does not apply its test filters or prove the actual test is development-disjoint; the later audit must measure overlaps.

feature_definitions.anchor_count: Parsed anchor tags, including anchors with no href.
feature_definitions.anchor_cross_site_count: HTTP(S) anchors whose destination site group differs from the page.
feature_definitions.anchor_fragment_or_empty_count: Anchors with empty/missing href or fragment-only href.
feature_definitions.anchor_http_count: Anchors with non-fragment references resolving to HTTP(S).
feature_definitions.anchor_invalid_count: Other anchor references that cannot be resolved to HTTP(S).
feature_definitions.context_identity_password_pair_form_coun: Forms owning password-cued and identity-cued controls; a combined label can cue both on one control.
feature_definitions.context_identity_password_pair_form_rati: Password/identity-pair forms divided by max(1,parsed forms).
feature_definitions.context_identitylike_control_count: User-entry controls with type=email or identity/email/username cues in labels/attributes.
feature_definitions.context_identitylike_control_ratio: Identity-cued controls divided by max(1,user-entry controls).
feature_definitions.context_label_only_passwordlike_control_: Non-password-type controls with a password cue only in associated label/aria-labelledby text.
feature_definitions.context_normalized_password_cue_control_: Controls with a password cue recognized only after normalization/common substitutions; not proof of obfuscation.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_control_count: User-entry controls with native type=password or password cues in associated labels/attributes.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_control_ratio: Password-cued controls divided by max(1,user-entry controls).
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_cross_site_form_cou: Password-cued forms with a resolved HTTP(S) action outside the page site group.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_form_count: Forms owning at least one password-cued control.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_get_form_count: Password-cued forms with missing/empty method or method=get.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_handler_form_count: Password-cued forms declaring onsubmit; presence is not observed execution.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_https_to_http_form_: Password-cued forms on HTTPS pages whose action resolves to HTTP.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_unowned_control_cou: Password-cued controls without a resolved form in this tolerant parser.
feature_definitions.context_plaintext_passwordlike_control_c: Password-cued controls whose declared type is not password; static declaration only.
feature_definitions.context_plaintext_passwordlike_fraction: Non-password-type password-cued controls divided by max(1,password-cued controls).
feature_definitions.context_plaintext_passwordlike_post_form: POST forms with a password-cued control without native type=password.
feature_definitions.context_user_entry_control_count: Parsed input text/password/email/tel/url/search/number controls and textareas; hidden/button controls excluded.
feature_definitions.credential_hint_input_count: Inputs with user/email/password/login/OTP hints in name/id/autocomplete; heuristic only.
feature_definitions.event_attribute_count: Attributes whose names begin with on; lexical event hints.
feature_definitions.form_cross_site_action_count: Forms whose resolved HTTP(S) action has a different site group.
feature_definitions.form_empty_action_count: Forms with missing or empty action.
feature_definitions.form_get_count: Forms with missing/empty method or method=get.
feature_definitions.form_https_to_http_action_count: Forms on HTTPS pages with resolved HTTP actions.
feature_definitions.form_invalid_action_count: Forms whose action cannot be interpreted as a valid HTTP(S) reference.
feature_definitions.form_non_http_action_count: Forms declaring a non-HTTP(S) action scheme.
feature_definitions.formaction_cross_site_count: Parsed input/button formaction overrides resolving to a different site group.
feature_definitions.formaction_override_count: Input/button elements declaring a formaction override.
feature_definitions.hidden_style_element_count: Elements declaring hidden or direct inline display:none/visibility:hidden.
feature_definitions.html_character_count: Full archived HTML character count, before the analysis cap.
feature_definitions.iframe_cross_site_count: Iframes with cross-site HTTP(S) src references.
feature_definitions.iframe_hidden_hint_count: Iframes with hidden/display:none/visibility:hidden or explicit zero width/height hints.
feature_definitions.inputs_without_resolved_form_count: Inputs not associated with a parsed form, including unresolved form attributes.
feature_definitions.js_analysed_character_count: JS characters actually scanned, capped globally per page; excludes external files and non-executable script types.
feature_definitions.js_atob_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \batob\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_char_code_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \b(?:fromCharCode|fromCodePoint)\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_cookie_reference_count: Lexical matches of regex \bdocument\s*\.\s*cookie\b in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_create_element_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bcreateElement\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_decode_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \b(?:unescape|decodeURI|decodeURIComponent)\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_document_write_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bdocument\s*\.\s*(?:write|writeln)\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_eval_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \beval\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_event_listener_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \baddEventListener\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_fetch_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bfetch\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_form_submit_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \.\s*(?:submit|requestSubmit)\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_function_constructor_count: Lexical matches of regex \b(?:new\s+)?Function\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_hex_unicode_escape_count: Lexical matches of regex \\(?:x[0-9a-f]{2}|u[0-9a-f]{4}|u\{[0-9a-f]+\}) in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_html_assignment_count: Lexical matches of regex \b(?:innerHTML|outerHTML)\s*=(?!=|>) in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_location_assignment_count: Lexical matches of regex \blocation\s*(?:\.\s*(?:href|host|hostname|pathname|search|hash)\s*)?=(?!=|>) in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_location_navigation_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \blocation\s*\.\s*(?:replace|assign|reload)\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_location_reference_count: Lexical matches of regex \blocation\b in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_password_hint_count: Lexical matches of regex \b(?:password|passwd|pwd)\b in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_prevent_default_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bpreventDefault\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_sendbeacon_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bsendBeacon\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_setinterval_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bsetInterval\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_settimeout_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bsetTimeout\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_storage_reference_count: Lexical matches of regex \b(?:localStorage|sessionStorage)\b in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_window_open_call_count: Lexical matches of regex \bwindow\s*\.\s*open\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.js_xhr_constructor_count: Lexical matches of regex \bXMLHttpRequest\s*\( in analysed inline/event/JS-URL code.
feature_definitions.meta_refresh_cross_site_count: Refresh tags with a parsed URL resolving to another site group.
feature_definitions.password_form_count: Forms associated with at least one parsed password input.
feature_definitions.password_form_cross_site_action_count: Password forms with a cross-site HTTP(S) action.
feature_definitions.script_cross_site_count: Nonempty script src references resolving to another site group.
feature_definitions.script_external_count: Script tags with a nonempty src; code contents are not downloaded.
feature_definitions.script_inline_executable_count: Inline script tags with empty/default, module, or recognised JS MIME type.
feature_definitions.script_non_executable_data_count: Script tags with other types, e.g. application/ld+json; not scanned as JS.
feature_definitions.tag_count: Opening tags encountered in the inspected HTML prefix.
feature_definitions.text_character_count: Text node characters outside script/style; not browser-visible text.
feature_definitions.text_input_count: Inputs with missing/empty type or type=text.

feature_extraction_contract.inference_contract: Use extract_enhanced_static_features() from this exact script 15 with original verified script 09 and these exact HTML/JS caps. Labels, site names and quality flags remain outside X.

test_protocol.after_test: Report the results as measured. Further model changes require a new independent holdout.
archive_eligibility: Valid supplied label and parseable HTTP(S) URL/site group under the existing grouping policy; no DNS lookup needed for archived analysis.
Non-null, non-whitespace archived HTML; no current resources fetched to replace missing historical JS.
Quarantine conflicting exact/whitespace-normalized content-label groups; do not relabel.
Deterministically retain one same-label exact copy, ranked by seed and record ID.
Keep parse/truncation/association-limit quality flags; do not exclude pages based on model scores.
development_overlap_audit: Audit record IDs, private-suffix-aware site groups, exact HTML and whitespace-normalized HTML against development data.
Primary clean cohort excludes test/development record, group and exact/normalized content overlaps.
Keep exclusions and overlap counts; these filters do not prove campaign/template independence.
test_protocol.official_split_only: Use the released test-*.parquet split; never move development rows into test.

primary_balanced_cohort.interpretation: A derived balanced, filtered cohort; do not call it the complete official-release benchmark.
primary_balanced_cohort.per_class_target: min(eligible benign count, eligible phish count); fail if either is zero.
primary_balanced_cohort.population: Eligible development-disjoint test archives after the stated filters.
primary_balanced_cohort.selection: Within each label, sort by SHA256(UTF8(str(seed) + '|' + record_id)), then record_id; take the target count.

test_protocol.quality_reporting: Report exclusions, coverage and class counts, plus metrics by capture-quality flags.
test_protocol.report_population: Record raw release counts and every exclusion reason before scoring.
test_protocol.scope: Static archived HTML/inline-JS baseline only; no live websites or dynamic-accuracy claim.

secondary_unbalanced_cohort.interpretation: Preserves this filtered cohort's class ratio; it does not establish real deployment prevalence.
secondary_unbalanced_cohort.population: All eligible development-disjoint archives before class balancing.

specification.threshold_role: Fixed static-baseline comparison; deployment alert policy is not selected.
